name: The Rocks District of Milton-Freewater

known.article: The Rocks District of Milton-Freewater AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "The Rocks District of Milton-Freewater AVA"

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Chardonnay, Merlot, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon and Riesling fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water. Loess is fine, wind-blown silt. Fertile and warm, it holds water well but drains poorly. River deposits are a mix of gravel, sand and silt. They are often fertile, so vines can grow vigorously.
soil.top: The topsoil holds plenty of water, which can push leafy, vigorous vines unless growers rein them in. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
